name: 木马骑罚 · 高吊骑坐
description: 第三人称：她骑坐在木马的棱脊上、双手被举过头顶吊在上方、脚尖勉强点地，体重全压在棱上；胸前有调教道具，她翻白眼大张着嘴哭喊
pose_tags: sitting, open mouth, bottomless, ahegao, rolled back eyes, wooden horse, slave, bound arms, wrists bound above her head, suspension, arms up, tears
pose_nl: she sits on a wooden horse with her arms bound high above her head. her toes barely touch the stage and tears run down her face. candlelight comes from one side.
